Meet the Emerging Producer! 
 Koleby Gilbert, founder of the Chattanooga Aperture Project, is a multi-media specialist raised in Chattanooga with a focus on storytelling, local event coordinating, and community-driven initiatives. He is constantly exploring the world of photography and looking for live music experiences of any genre. On September 24, Koleby will host Depth of Field Day, an event bringing free photography-based workshops and a photography showcase to East M L King Boulevard.
 Depth of Field Day was created to elevate and celebrate the photographic talent of the Chattanooga area. Taking place at the Small Business Resource Center, the workshops will address a range of topics for photography enthusiasts of all skill levels. Depth of Field Day will conclude with the Aperture Exhibition at the Bessie Smith Cultural Center, featuring work by photographers from across the city. 
 Following Depth of Field Day, Koleby will partner with Safelight District to host a Darkroom Community Day on September 25. Each event provides an accessible opportunity to learn photography techniques and celebrate local talent. 
 Learn more and RSVP at https://buff.ly/pCfqJRW

 Aperture Exhibition & Reception:
 📅 September 24, 5:30-9 PM

Today, we joined EPB and IonQ for the launch of the IonQ Forte Enterprise quantum computer at the EPB Quantum Center, another major step in our community’s emergence as a hub for quantum technology.
 As this industry grows, we’re making sure our students grow with it. From the new Energy and Quantum Industries Academy at Franklin Roberts Future Ready Center to early exposure through TN QuantumWorks, Hamilton County students are gaining pathways to prepare for careers in advanced energy, broadband, cybersecurity, and quantum technology.
 No other community in the region is doing this quite like Hamilton County, developing local talent while attracting people from across America who want to be part of the momentum happening here.

🌿💐 Welcome to Red Bank, Malin Flowers & Gifts! 💐🌿
 There’s a beautiful new shop in town, and it’s one you’ll want to step inside and experience for yourself.
 On September 3rd, Erin officially opened the doors to Malin Flowers & Gifts, a thoughtfully designed shop filled with fresh blooms, Scandinavian-inspired flowers and gifts, and beautifully curated goods.
 The space itself is quaint, inviting, and full of thoughtful details — but one of the most unique features is the “Gathering Wall.” 🌸
 The idea is simple: gather what speaks to you.
 Whether you're looking for a Gesture, Moment, Gathering, or Home bouquet, the wall gives you a simple way to create something beautiful, even if you’ve never known quite what to choose for a bouquet. Find the colors, textures, and blooms that catch your eye, follow the “recipe,” and create a bouquet that feels like you. And if you’d rather leave the arranging to Erin, there are beautiful premade bouquets ready to go, too. 💐
 And then there’s the “Thrift” shelf — a collection of vases Erin has personally thrifted. Find one you love, take it home with your flowers, and bring the vase back the next time you need a bouquet for a discounted fee. What a lovely way to give something old a new life. 🤍
 And don’t leave without trying the Cardamom Shortbread Cookies made especially for Malin by Cohutta Provisions. 🍪 They’re the perfect little treat to enjoy while taking in all the beautiful things around you.
 From fresh flowers and thoughtfully selected gifts to handcrafted 3D cards, cookbooks, candles, and more, Malin Flowers & Gifts is the kind of place where you can find something special for someone you love — or simply something beautiful for yourself.
 🌿 Fresh blooms. Thoughtful gifts. Beautiful gatherings.
 📍 Find Malin Flowers & Gifts
 3890 Dayton Blvd
 Chattanooga, TN 37415
 🕙 Hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 10 AM–6 PM
 We’re so happy to welcome Erin and Malin Flowers & Gifts to the Red Bank community. Be sure to stop in, explore the Gathering Wall, find a vase you love, and discover all the little treasures tucked inside.
 💐 Welcome to Red Bank, Malin! 🤍

items.content_text:
For 70+ years in Red Bank, Tennessee…Dub’s Place has been serving up some of the tastiest burgers, shakes and ice cream in the Chattanooga area! This old-school roadside stop first opened in 1952 and has remained a local favorite on Dayton Boulevard ever since. Just about ten minutes from downtown Chattanooga, it has the feel of a classic neighborhood burger joint, with license plates and vintage touches covering the walls. The owner is a trained chef, and you may even spot him working the grill and talking with customers while fresh burgers, barbecue and thick-cut fries are being made. One longtime favorite is the original 1952 Crumble Burger, which is still on the menu today alongside half-pound hand-packed burgers, hot dogs and smoked meats. Save room for something cold because Dub’s also serves hand-dipped ice cream, sundaes and thick milkshakes. It’s the kind of simple, old-fashioned Tennessee stop that has kept people coming back for generations!

Almost half of 15-year-olds across #OECD countries now use #AI for learning at least once a week. But the latest #OECDPISA results show that how they use it matters. 
 Students who use AI to write text for assignments score lower on average in science than students who do not.  
 Students who frequently used AI for learning and received guidance on how to assess the quality of AI-generated information performed better on science than frequent users without guidance. 
 As AI becomes part of the classroom, education systems need to ensure it strengthens students' learning, critical thinking and problem-solving skills, rather than replacing them.

Gas Line Work Beginning on Ooltewah-Ringgold Road 🚧
 Construction on a new underground regulator station and pipeline serving the Collegedale area is scheduled to begin the week of September 14 (this week). If you're traveling through the area, you may start seeing crews and equipment out soon, if not already.
 The project is part of a pressure improvement program approved by the Collegedale City Commission in August. Crews will connect new pipeline into the existing gas line near Bill Reed Road/Wellesley Drive area, run pipe north along Ooltewah-Ringgold Road to a new regulator station being built near the Apison Pike intersection, then continue the pipe past Apison Pike to reconnect with the existing line further north. The system will be tested before going into service.
 What to expect:
 ▪️No full road closures — single-lane traffic will be maintained
 ▪️Short (~200 ft) lane restrictions that shift as work progresses
 ▪️All business and property entrances will stay open
 ▪️Work may occasionally continue into weekends
 Traffic control is being coordinated with TDOT for your safety.
 Stay updated: www.collegedaletn.gov/chattanooga_gas_company_eas…/index.php
 Questions? Call us at (423) 396-3135!

🥧 FROM CULINARY SCHOOL TO RED BANK: THE SWEET STORY BEHIND PIE R SQUARE
 RED BANK, TN — Sometimes the best local businesses begin with a simple idea: “We need one of those here.”
 For Pie R Square, that idea was pie — real, homemade, from-scratch pie — and nearly eight years later, that vision has become a Red Bank favorite.
 Located at 4403 Dayton Blvd., Pie R Square got its start after the owner’s daughter attended culinary school in Atlanta and worked at a pie shop after graduation. When she returned home to Chattanooga, she decided our community needed a pie shop of its own.
 So, she started creating her own pies — from the crust to the filling to the toppings — everything homemade.
 What began on a small scale at local farmers markets has grown into a storefront right here in Red Bank, where Pie R Square has been serving up sweet and savory creations for nearly eight years.
 🥧 Something New Every Week
 Pie lovers can find a weekly rotating menu of 4-inch pies, making it easy to try different flavors throughout the year.
 And if you have a gathering, celebration, or just a serious craving, you can order a 9-inch pie with two days' advance notice.
 One flavor that deserves a special mention? Their coconut pie. 🥥🥧
 If you've ever had a homemade coconut pie that reminds you of Grandma's kitchen, you know exactly what we're talking about. Pie R Square's coconut pie tastes just like Grandma's! It's the kind of pie that brings back memories with the very first bite.
 🍗 Don't Forget the Savory Pies!
 Pie isn't just for dessert!
 Pie R Square also offers frozen chicken pot pies that are perfect to grab for an easy dinner at home or keep on hand for a special occasion. Just because dinner is quick doesn't mean it can't be delicious.
 🎃 Thanksgiving Is Coming!
 Starting November 1st, Pie R Square will begin taking Thanksgiving orders with a special holiday menu featuring both sweet and savory pies.
 And yes, the classics will be there! 🎃
 You'll be able to order their pumpkin pie along with their pumpkin cream cheese pie — a customer favorite that's truly something special.
 Whether you're looking for a traditional Thanksgiving dessert or want to bring something unexpected to the holiday table, Pie R Square will have plenty of options.
 🎉 More Than Just Pie
 Pie R Square also offers catering for weddings, business events, parties, celebrations, and other special occasions.
 Need something unique for your next event? Give them a call and see what they can create!
 From culinary school in Atlanta, to farmers markets around Chattanooga, to a storefront right here in Red Bank, the story of Pie R Square is one of a family turning a passion into a local business — one homemade pie at a time. ❤️
 📍 Pie R Square
 4403 Dayton Blvd.
 Chattanooga, TN
 🕒 Hours:
 Wednesday–Saturday: 12:00 PM–7:00 PM

 📱 Follow Pie R Square on Facebook & Instagram: @Piersquare2

🎨 Happy National Arts in Education Week! 🎭🎶🩰

 Arts teachers do so much more than teach us how to paint, play an instrument, dance, perform, or create. They help us find our voices, build confidence, take risks, see the world differently, and discover talents we may not have known we had. For many of us, an arts teacher was one of the first people to truly see something special in us.
 At ArtsBuild, we believe every young person deserves access to meaningful arts experiences and great arts education. Through Imagine! and our other arts education initiatives, we work alongside Hamilton County educators and cultural partners to make the arts part of learning for thousands of students each year.
 Now we want to hear from you! ❤️
 Who was an arts teacher who made a difference in your life? Maybe it was your elementary school art teacher, band director, choir teacher, theater teacher, dance instructor, or someone who simply encouraged you to create.
 Give them a shout-out in the comments and tell us what made them special!

Save the date for CIVIQ: A Speaker Series Honoring Robert Taylor!
 CIVIQ is a free speaker series showcasing national and international ideas in urban design and creating space for conversations about how cities can approach the challenges facing their communities.
 On October 29, CIVIQ welcomes Carol Coletta for a timely conversation about Chattanooga’s riverfront: “Evergreen for Everyone, Everyday: Is It Possible?”
 Carol Coletta is a national leader in civic design and public innovation. As president and CEO of Memphis River Parks Partnership, she led a new riverfront concept plan, the renaming and redesign of two parks, the development of a five-mile bike-pedestrian trail, and the design and construction of Tom Lee Park, an internationally acclaimed riverfront park in Memphis.
 With Chattanooga preparing to enter the next phase of its riverfront parks, this is a conversation worth hearing. Come hear Coletta’s perspective and consider what’s possible for Chattanooga’s riverfront. 
 📍 Downtown Branch - Chattanooga Public Library
 📅 October 29, 5:30-7:00 PM
 🎟️ RSVP: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/civiq-a-speaker-series-honorin…
